# Inova Painting Corp

> Owner-led residential and commercial painting contractor based in Medway, Massachusetts, USA. Founded by Junior Batista, who has about 24 years of hands-on painting experience. Licensed and insured. Rated 4.9 out of 5 from 168 reviews on Thumbtack, hired 216 times there, Thumbtack Top Pro 2020–2025.

Key facts:

- Phone (call or text): +1 (781) 420-5111
- Email: inovapaintingma@gmail.com
- Address: 11 Villa Street, Medway, MA 02053, USA
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 7am to 5pm
- Service area: Medway, Franklin, Millis, Holliston, Milford, Bellingham, Norfolk, Hopkinton, Ashland, Sherborn, Walpole, Natick and nearby towns (about 20 miles around Medway)
- How quotes work: request a quote by form, call or text; Junior visits for an in-person assessment and sends a detailed written estimate
- Interior painting: walls, ceilings, trim and molding, cabinet painting with a sprayed finish
- Exterior painting: siding and walls, exterior trim, spray, brush and roller
- Commercial painting: interior and exterior, scheduled for minimal downtime
- Additional services: popcorn ceiling removal, wallpaper removal, power washing
- Not offered: epoxy floor coatings
